== Acquisition ==
Automatically equipped upon entry to [[Dragon Arena]].

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Shock}}

== Notes ==
* This skill [[knock down|knocks down]] the target.
* This skill activates faster than [[Dragon Blast]], so it is useful at close distances.

== Trivia ==
* The word [[w:Kowtow|kowtow]] is a Chinese term that refers to kneeling and bowing so low that your head touches the ground.
